lines: You wake up under yesterday's {paper}. The tramontana takes it back out to sea.
Somebody covered you with the {paper}. A gull is reading the sports pages.
You slept under the {paper}'s shipping forecast. It said: wind. It was right.
You fell asleep holding a slice of focaccia. You are no longer holding a slice of focaccia.
A gull stands on the back of the bench, chewing. You check your pockets. Your focaccia is gone.
A wave comes over the quay wall and finds you. Good morning from the Ligurian Sea.
Salt spray all night. You wake up seasoned.
Nonna's basket is on the bench beside you. A note inside: 'Go home to bed. P.S. Are you eating?'
A basket on a rope sways next to your head. Inside, a blanket and a note: 'From the third floor.'

done: {title}: done, and Il Gabbiano was there before the gulls
Geometra finishes {title}; the Comandante grumbles, which means he's pleased
{title} completed. Baciccia says it cost too many lire. He would
built: {n} new pieces in Tonnarella overnight; the gulls have already sat on all of them
Geometra puts up {n} pieces while the town argued about the price of bread in euros
{n} new pieces by the sea, and the tramontana didn't take a single one
opened: Comandante Traverso opens {what} {place}, with a speech that starts as a complaint
Ribbon cut on {what} {place}. Rosetta brought focaccia; the gulls brought themselves
{What} {place}: the Comandante calls it 'acceptable', the highest honour in the harbour
quiet: Quiet day in Tonnarella. The tramontana blew; nobody built anything
Nothing built yesterday. The queue at the bank was the longest thing in town
Slow news day: a gull stole a whole focaccia from the bakery, again
paper.verdict: Il Gabbiano's verdict on the new build: {grade}.
paper.regrown: Overnight the sea threw up more driftwood, and the capers and the mussels grew back.

inauguration.speaker: port_lorenzo
open: Citizens of Tonnarella. I have a complaint. It is about {what} {place}. I complain that it wasn't here before.
Gather round, out of the wind. {What} {place}. I had a list of objections. I've lost the list.
As harbour master, I am required to open {what} {place}. As a Genoese sailor, I am required to grumble about it. First, the grumbling.

need: Il Gabbiano wrote: “{noticed}” For once the gulls' paper got something right.
own: Right here, where we needed it. I said so in a letter in 1994.
art: What is it for? Nothing. Like the castle. We love the castle.
tall: Tall. You can see it from the breakwater. I checked.
colour: A colour. In a town of faded paint, that's practically a scandal. Good.
many: {n} pieces in a day. The Navy takes a year to send a letter.
single: One {piece}. The harbour began with one stone, too. It fell in the sea.
plain: It stands, it's square, and the tramontana hasn't moved it. That's all I ask.
Sound work. I kicked it. It didn't move. My foot did.

close: The Geometra did the work. I did the grumbling. Scissors!
My complaints are withdrawn. For today. Cut the ribbon.
Well built, and on time, which in this harbour is a miracle. The mugugno is over. Ribbon!

buildings.name: A palazzo over the fish market

machines.label: The lift's drive (in the machine room's east wall)
The lighthouse's turning gear (in the tower's west wall)

nodes.text: A biscuit tin wedged under a step, stuffed with lire from 1956. Nonna's!
Behind a loose brick in the lane wall: a cocoa tin of thousand-lire notes, rolled tight.
Under a geranium pot that hasn't moved since 1961: a tin of lire, and a recipe for pesto.
In a hole by the drainpipe, a tin of anchovies that isn't anchovies. It's lire.
Under the belvedere's bench, a tin marked BUTTONS. It isn't buttons.

fish.name: Scorpionfish

features.text: Tonnarella. Trains for Toriano. The lift to the harbour is out of order: the stairs are to your left.
Coast ferry: Serenza, Liolivato. No service until further notice.

features.name: Your flat
features.arrive_text: 112 steps down. Your knees counted them too.

features.name: Lighthouse door
features.arrive_text: Up the spiral stair to the gallery. The whole bay below you.

features.name: The gallery
features.arrive_text: Down the spiral stair, round and round.
